title: Telemetry Event Envelope
description: The common envelope every telemetry event conforms to, emitted identically by the eval harness (source=eval) and production (source=production). The payload shape depends on event_name; payloads for safety-critical events are defined in event_payloads_schema.json, the rest in event_catalog.md.

event_id.description: Unique id for this event. Injected, never ambient — required for deterministic replay.

event_name.description: Dot-delimited event name matching the module/domain path, e.g. 'commitment.executed', 'guest.question.answered'. See event_catalog.md for the full set.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Injected, never read from an ambient clock.

trace_id.description: Correlates all events of one run (eval) or one planning session/lifecycle (production).

wedding_id.description: The wedding being planned — the aggregate root all metrics group by.

capability.description: Which product capability emitted the event. Powers the per_capability_scorecard. See vocabularies.md#capability.

actor.description: Who or what triggered the event. See vocabularies.md#actor.

source.description: Whether this event came from an eval run or production. The schema is identical for both.

guest_id.description: Present on guest-scoped events. An identifier only — never raw PII.

payload.description: Event-specific data. Carries identifiers, not raw PII (see README privacy discipline). Safety-critical payloads are constrained in event_payloads_schema.json; others are specified in event_catalog.md and should be materialized as JSON Schema as the product is built.

schema_version.description: Version of this telemetry contract the event was emitted under.

product_version.description: Set when source=production (or the product-under-test version in eval).

seed.description: Run determinism seed; set when source=eval.
